title: Proxy and deployment choices
decision: Rate limits by address of 20 requests a second in general, 30 a minute on sign-in, 5 a second on the payment endpoints and a wider 30 a second on the Telegram webhook; body limits equal to the application's; HSTS for one year without subdomains or preload; the Mini App may be framed only by Telegram's web clients and the panels by nobody; the proxy always issues the request identifier; images are tagged by commit and built on the host because there is no registry; container resource limits are unmeasured starting values
context: Decided by an agent during the autonomous build under DEC-020; implemented and awaiting the founder's review
chosen_option: Choices as listed in pull request 60
rationale: The architecture asks for limits and headers at the proxy and gives no numbers
